items.title: Joey Morant interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013
items.q: I worked with James Brown, my cousin managed James Brown

ctx.x: It’s 6:30 now, so we can wrap this up and we’ll do Part II down the road.

Okay buddy. But I appreciate what you’re doing. I appreciate it. I’ve been told also in the last twenty years at least, I’ve got to write a book. I’ve got a hell of a book to write. I can write in chapters, in segments, and verify it. Most of what I say I can verify. I mean I worked with Ray Charles and I — but see I didn’t come here today really to sell me. Because I could have said all of that but I didn’t. I worked with James Brown, my cousin managed James Brown — and so I could write a book at least that…
usually a musician will not go down that many roads. He’s too busy trying to play. So I found a way to do all of it.
